verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it-in-browser examples. The pack does show docs-as-Markdown, llms.txt, an MCP server for docs access, and SDK skills, but these are adjacent agent-readable documentation features rather than an interactive, runnable API explorer. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on all candidate paths, so there is no published spec that would back such an explorer.
